name: quorum
description: A spec-to-pull-request verification pipeline: researched specs and plans reviewed before any code, fresh-context code review with a verifier vote, a security pass, a blind user test with accessibility checks, and hooks that block "done" until the repo's checks pass. Scales to each task's risk tier and turns repeated mistakes into review rules.

max_rounds.title: Max review rounds
max_rounds.description: Hard cap on review-loop rounds before a task is HALTED.

nit_cap.title: Nit cap
nit_cap.description: Most [NIT] findings kept per review pass.

stop_hook_enabled.title: Stop-hook checks
stop_hook_enabled.description: Run the repo's verify-completion.sh when Claude or the builder finishes during a task.

verify_timeout_s.title: Check timeout (seconds)
verify_timeout_s.description: Timeout for verify-completion.sh (the hook itself times out at 1800).

worktrees.title: A worktree per task
worktrees.description: Build each task in its own git worktree (.claude/worktrees/<slug>), so this working tree stays free for other tasks. Needs CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md, and the check script committed. /quorum:build --worktree does it for one task.

security_on_medium.title: Security pass for MEDIUM
security_on_medium.description: Also run the security reviewer for MEDIUM-risk tasks (it always runs for HIGH).

reviewer_model.title: Reviewer model
reviewer_model.description: Model for the spec, plan, and code reviewers, the security reviewer, and the voter: ask (each task asks once), inherit (the session's model), or a model name or ID Claude Code accepts.

helper_model.title: Helper model
helper_model.description: Model for the PR writer and the friction triager: ask (each task asks once), inherit (the session's model), or a model name or ID Claude Code accepts.

blind_block_dirs.title: Blind test: blocked folders
blind_block_dirs.description: Comma-separated folders the blind user may not read.

blind_block_exts.title: Blind test: blocked file types
blind_block_exts.description: Comma-separated file extensions the blind user may not read.
